title: Story premise ENT118: The Lost-and-Found Silhouette
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: The mitten is lost inside lost-and-found. Takeaway/theme: Organization helps only if people can find the organized place.
description: A community host wants to reunite a visitor with a missing mitten, but the lost-and-found box is a jumble. They hang simple item silhouettes above open compartments; the visitor finds the mitten in the matching shape area and leaves a little drawing showing where the box is for the next person.
